Chad
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Brussels
Regular biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Brussels
Service/Official biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Brussels
Diplomatic biometric passport YES Visa shall be issued in Brussels
Citizens of the Republic of Chad are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Cairo, Egypt.
